label: November 10
title: The Life Church Started Weekly Services
paragraph: The Life Church of Memphis began holding regular weekly services, laying the foundation for a church committed to reaching people and making a difference in the local community.

label: Summer
title: Sent First Global Missions Team
paragraph: The Life Church sent its first short-term missions team to Nairobi, Kenya, beginning a legacy of serving people and taking the hope of Jesus around the world.
stat: 209 different teams sent on mission trips since 1998

label: January
title: Leased Office Space in Cordova
paragraph: Slot reserved for the late-90s highlight still being chosen: the attendance barrier, the inaugural baptism, or the first office space on Bonnie Lane.
stat: 16 cell groups meeting, with an average of 160 people attending

label: Fall
title: Leased First Billboard
paragraph: The Life Church launched Reaching Forward in Faith, its first giving campaign focused on the church’s future, and placed its first billboard on Germantown Parkway in front of the Home Builders Association Building.
stat: The Home Builders Association Building was demolished and rebuilt as a CVS Pharmacy

label: October 28
title: Celebrated 5 Years as a Church
paragraph: The Life Church celebrated five years of ministry in Memphis, giving thanks for all God had done and looking ahead to all He would do.
stat: Headed into the 5th anniversary with 21 days of prayer and fasting, then 24 hours of prayer straight through

label: March 31
title: Hosted First Service at Permanent Building
paragraph: The Life Church moved into its first building, creating a permanent home for worship services, ministry and reaching people in Memphis.
stat: At one point we hosted six services every weekend to keep up with attendance

label: September 22
title: Hosted Reinhard Bonnke For Miracle Service
paragraph: The Life Church hosted evangelist Reinhard Bonnke for a special Miracle Service, creating a powerful moment of ministry and faith for the church.
stat: Bonnke’s ministry documented more than 79 million salvation decisions

label: Spring
title: Launched Zoe Women’s Ministry
paragraph: The Life Church established a dedicated women’s ministry (now Zoe), creating opportunities for women to grow in their faith, build relationships and encourage one another.

label: August
title: Launched Leadership Internship Program
paragraph: Recognizing the importance of developing leaders in God’s House, The Life Church established its Damascus Road internship program (renamed Life Leadership) to mentor and train the next generation of Christian leaders.

label: September
title: Canceled Sunday Services to Serve
paragraph: In response to Hurricane Katrina, The Life Church canceled regular Sunday morning services and mobilized volunteers and resources to serve those affected by the storm in Biloxi, Mississippi and Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

label: Spring
title: Launched Vision Partners Ministry
paragraph: The Life Church established Kingdom Builders (renamed Kingdom Partners and then Vision Partners), a new ministry focused on engaging church members in strategic generosity to move the church’s vision forward and make a greater kingdom impact.

label: March 6–7
title: Hosted First Make Room Event
paragraph: The Life Church launched Make Room, an event to equip and inspire pastors and other church leaders to build the local church, develop their teams and grow their leadership.

label: Early
title: Launched TV Program
paragraph: Extending its reach beyond weekend services at its Germantown Parkway location, The Life Church began broadcasting services on television, bringing the worship and teaching experience to thousands of homes across the region.

label: Early
title: Launched Collierville Location at YMCA
paragraph: The Life Church expanded its presence in the Memphis area by opening its second location at the YMCA in Collierville.
stat: This location moved to the Houston Levee property in 2010

label: July 13–16
title: Hosted First Axis Conference
paragraph: The Life Church held the first Axis Student Conference (renamed Axis Nation and then Axis Conference) for students in 6th–12th grade, beginning an annual multi-day event for the next generation to encounter God.

label: Fall
title: Launched FeedMemphis Outreach Initiative
paragraph: The Life Church launched FeedMemphis, an ongoing outreach initiative to combat food insecurity by meeting practical needs.
stat: Memphis was named the “Hunger Capital of the United States” in 2010, with 26% of the metro area struggling to afford food

label: February 9
title: Launched East Memphis Location
paragraph: The Life Church opened a new location in East Memphis at the Malco Paradiso theater, expanding to its third location in the Memphis area.
stat: The 7-acre campus it moved to was founded in 1941 as the Mid-South Bible Center

label: May 25
title: Launched The Life Church — Santiago
paragraph: The Life Church opened an international location in Santiago, Chile, expanding the church’s reach outside of the United States.
stat: Launched on Pastor John’s birthday

label: September 18–20
title: Hosted First Zoe Conference
paragraph: The Life Church launched Life Women’s Conference (now Zoe Conference), a gathering for ladies of all ages to encounter God and grow in strength, friendship and purpose.

label: August
title: Started Read to Lead After-School Program
paragraph: The Life Church launched an after-school literacy program, creating opportunities for underserved children in the Raleigh community to develop their reading and leadership skills.
stat: In its first eight years, 83.3% of the children saw reading scores rise and school suspensions fall

label: December
title: Hosted First Sound of Christmas
paragraph: The Life Church launched The Sound of Christmas, an annual holiday production bringing spectacular music and a message of hope to the Christmas season.
stat: Nearly all of the vocalists, choir, musicians and dancers are volunteers and staff of The Life Church

label: May
title: Broke Ground on New Houston Levee Facility
paragraph: The Life Church began construction at a new facility on Houston Levee Road, creating additional space to serve a growing church and expanding vision.
stat: The church met in the original Collierville building for seven years before expanding

label: September 9–10
title: Houston Levee Auditorium Grand Opening
paragraph: The Life Church opened its new Houston Levee facility, providing a new home for worship services, conferences and ministry throughout the week.
stat: From around 400 seats to 2,000

label: April 21
title: Launched the Austin Peay Location
paragraph: The Life Church opened a new location on Austin Peay Highway, expanding its presence to the Raleigh area of Memphis and making it possible to reach more people.
stat: Launched by merging with The House Church

label: Summer
title: Sent a Record 21 Global Mission Teams
paragraph: The Life Church sent 21 mission teams around the world, taking the Gospel to the nations and serving communities across five continents.
stat: Colombia, Cuba, Ethiopia, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Japan and Zimbabwe

label: April 12
title: Launched The Life Church — New York
paragraph: The Life Church established its first location in New York with Lead Pastors Wayne and Classy Francis, expanding the church’s reach from the South to the Northeast.
stat: Merged with Authentic Church and launched during the COVID-19 pandemic

label: September
title: Launched Leadership in Black & White Podcast
stat: In January 2022 it joined the K-LOVE podcast family and went weekly

label: October 17
title: Launched The Life Church — Massachusetts
paragraph: The Life Church opened a location in Massachusetts with Lead Pastor Emy Vazquez, expanding its presence into the Northeast.

label: November 10
title: Celebrated 25th Anniversary
paragraph: The Life Church celebrated 25 years of ministry, giving thanks for all God had done and looking ahead to the future.

label: January 30
title: Launched The Life Church — Italy
paragraph: The Life Church established a location in Florence, Italy with Pastors Marco and Tiina Geraci, expanding the church’s international reach into Europe.

label: June
title: Axis Conference Sold Out
paragraph: Axis Conference reached capacity at 2,000 students for the first time, marking a significant milestone in the conference’s growth beyond a local youth conference.

label: January
title: Hosted First Revival Nights
paragraph: The Life Church launched Revival Nights, powerful services to encounter God’s presence through worship, teaching and prayer.
stat: Speakers have included Chad Veach, Charlotte Gambill, Dr. Manny Arango, Earl McClellan and Rich Wilkerson, Jr.

label: March 19
title: Launched The Life Church — DC Metro
paragraph: The Life Church opened a location serving the DC metropolitan area, expanding its US presence into the nation’s capital.

label: March 19–20
title: Hosted First International Make Room Event
paragraph: The Life Church took Make Room internationally for the first time, hosting the leadership event for pastors and church leaders in Santiago, Chile.
stat: Over 30 churches represented and more than 200 pastors and leaders from across South America

label: March 3
title: Launched The Life Church — South Africa
paragraph: The Life Church opened its third international location in Johannesburg, South Africa, one of the largest cities in Africa.

label: March 31
title: Launched First Prison Location
paragraph: The Life Church established a location at the Shelby County Division of Corrections, bringing the hope of Jesus to incarcerated men through weekly Sunday services.

label: June
title: Released Axis Worship Original Song
paragraph: Axis Worship released its first original song, marking a creative milestone for the church’s youth worship ministry.

label: September 8
title: Launched The Life Church — Nashville
paragraph: The Life Church opened a location in the Bellevue area of Nashville.

label: February 23
title: Launched Second Prison Location
paragraph: The Life Church expanded its prison ministry with a second location serving inmates at the 201 Poplar facility.

label: August 8
title: Groundbreaking for Global Hub & Next Gen Building
paragraph: The Life Church began construction on the Global Hub & Next Generation Building, creating space to better serve the church today and create opportunities for life change for future generations.

label: September 1
title: Launched Life Leadership Bible School
paragraph: The Life Church launched Life Leadership Bible School, a two-year online program designed to grow biblical literacy and develop committed, world-class leaders in the body of Christ.
stat: 350 students enrolled in the inaugural class, from six countries
